id: A Night With A.R.T-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: A Night With A.R.T
long_description:
A NIGHT WITH A.R.T | ALBUM RELEASE PARTY

Two-time Pacific Music Award winners A.R.T are bringing their biggest headline show yet to their hometown of Wellington, celebrating the release of their debut album with an intimate night of live music at The Rogue & Vagabond on Saturday 21 November 2026.

After an incredible year of releasing a new song every month through their ambitious First Thursdays project, the Wellington-based vocal trio are bringing it all together for a special album release celebration.

Known for their powerhouse vocals, rich harmonies and signature blend of R&B, soul and reggae, A.R.T have quickly established themselves as one of Aotearoa's most exciting rising acts. With fan favourites including *When He Was Mine*, *Over Now* and *Easy*, the trio have built a loyal following across New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific.

For one night only, A.R.T will perform a full headline set backed by their live band, featuring music from their new album alongside the songs that have helped shape their journey so far.

Joining them as special guest is OCE, setting the tone for an unforgettable night celebrating local music, connection and the next chapter for A.R.T.


EVENT DETAILS

Date: Saturday 21 November 2026
Venue: The Rogue & Vagabond, 18 Garrett Street, Wellington

Playing Times:

9:00pm | Doors Open
9:30pm | OCE
10:00pm | A.R.T (with Live Band)

Tickets: https://tickets.ticketspace.co.nz/tickets/a-r-t-album-release-party-wellington

Venue Accessibility: The Rogue & Vagabond is listed as wheelchair accessible. Patrons with specific accessibility requirements are encouraged to contact the venue directly before attending.

An intimate celebration of a milestone year for A.R.T, this is a night not to be missed.
